text:
ashley: Heads-up UX thread — ran into a few friction points in the playground invoke flow when tool schemas are large and the run history is visible.
jamal: yeah? what popped up for you?
ashley: Primary: on small widths the helper drawer sits on top of the run history and there's no clear affordance to move between them. Copying structured outputs becomes a pain.
sara: +1 saw that. also the helper header label is "Args" which feels terse and not screen-reader friendly.
elaine: Suggest 'Function inputs (schema)' or 'Input schema' instead. explicit is better for non-developer readers.
mike: Accessibility issue: when opening the helper from a history entry, focus remains on the history item. Screen readers never announce the helper, and tab order gets confusing.
ashley: Repro: open playground -> click function definition -> click a history entry -> helper appears but VO not announcing. Proposed: set focus to the helper container and fire an aria-live polite message like "Function inputs panel opened". Also add role=\"dialog\" + aria-modal when it's overlayed.
jamal: Copy behavior: 'Copy' button copies compact JSON. Suggest changing label to 'Copy JSON' and adding a small menu to 'Copy pretty' / 'Copy compact'. Or default to compact but allow a modifier (shift-click) for pretty.
sara: tiny toast needed: "Copied JSON" with the format (Pretty/Compact). Also support keyboard shortcut — maybe Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C to copy pretty.
mike: UI contrast nit: the 'beta' badge on the helper header doesn't meet 3:1 contrast. We'll need a darker background or darker text per WCAG. Filing a contrast fix ticket.
elaine: For long param descriptions in the schema preview, clamp to 2 lines and show a 'Show more' chevron. This keeps the helper compact and reduces layout shift.
jamal: For run-history list items that include tool outputs, can we inline a micro-preview showing up to 3 top-level keys? e.g., "title: Draft · id: xyz · status: done". Clickable to open the helper.
sara: Love that. Keep it low-contrast so it doesn't compete with main content. And make each key an interactive hit target for keyboard users.
mike: Also: hide internal keys starting with underscore (e.g. _meta) by default. Add a 'Show hidden fields' toggle in the helper; default off. The toggle should be a real toggle button with aria-pressed and keyboard focus.
ashley: UX micro-spec for the preview (pseudo):

```
// micro-preview
const preview = Object.entries(obj)
  .filter(([k]) => !k.startsWith('_'))
  .slice(0,3)
  .map(([k,v]) => `${k}: ${shortenForPreview(v)}`)
  .join(' \u00b7 ')
function shortenForPreview(v){
  const s = String(v)
  return s.length > 24 ? s.slice(0,21) + '...' : s
}
```

jamal: Nice. Make sure shortenForPreview doesn't cut in the middle of escape sequences or break emojis. Also prefer a word-boundary truncation if possible.
elaine: Accessibility: when toggling hidden fields, announce counts, e.g. "Showing 3 of 7 fields" via aria-live. And when collapsing/expanding descriptions, ensure the control has aria-expanded.
sara: Keyboard shortcuts idea: under the helper header show a subtle hint row: Esc = close · C = copy · P = prettify. Could namespace later (g then c) if conflicts arise. Must be discoverable via a help tooltip.
mike: Implementation note: drawer mode vs docked mode — on wide screens it should dock (no overlay), on narrow screens it overlays and traps focus. We need to explicitly support both with clear role/aria attributes.
ashley: I'll mock an update: micro-preview in history, 'Function inputs (schema)' header, pretty/compact copy options, hidden-fields toggle, and a11y announcements. Posting a short prototype before the 2pm UX sync.
ux-bot: Reminder: UX sync @ 2:00pm today. Add your prototypes to the agenda card: https://redwood.example/kanban/ux/proto.
ashley: Thanks — will add. Posting current prototype PNG in the thread when ready :sparkles:\"
